en: A person who has nothing for which he is willing to fight, nothing which is more important than his own personal safety, is a miserable creature and has no chance of being free unless made and kept so by the exertions of better men than himself.
zh: 一個沒有什麼理由值得他挺身奮戰、認為除了自身安危之外別無更重要之事的人，是可悲的生物；除非有比他更優秀的人挺身奮鬥、替他爭取並捍衛，否則他絕無可能獲得自由。
